# OmniOperand (omnioperand.com)
> High-precision quantitative computing engine, bidirectional geometric solvers, and exact radical mathematical derivations.

## Overview
OmniOperand provides rigorously verified computational solvers across Pure and Applied Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Construction Engineering, and Physiological Bio-Quant. Each tool offers closed-form algebraic solutions, exact radical constants, step-by-step proofs, zero floating-point approximation drift, and automated machine API endpoints.

## Commercial API & Autonomous AI Agent Services
- [REST API & OpenAPI 3.1 Schema](https://omnioperand.com/api/): Full machine-readable schema for ChatGPT Custom Actions, Claude MCP, and autonomous AI agents.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://omnioperand.com/mcp/schemas.json): Stdio and HTTP MCP server exposing deterministic mathematical tools with explicit system prompts.
- [Developer & Enterprise Pricing](https://omnioperand.com/pricing/): Metered API tiers (Free: 500 req/mo, Pro: 50,000 req/mo at $29/mo, Enterprise: $199/mo).
- [Embeddable Widgets (CaaS)](https://omnioperand.com/embed/): Standalone zero-dependency calculator widget engine with isolated Shadow DOM.

## Domain Hubs
- [Quantitative Finance & Lending Hub](https://omnioperand.com/finance/): Calculators for mortgages, debt refinancing, HELOCs, real estate underwriting, tax liabilities, and compound interest models.
- [Construction & Trades Engineering Hub](https://omnioperand.com/construction/): High-precision solvers for concrete volumes, framing, aggregate tonnage, roofing squares, HVAC thermal loads, and electrical circuits.
- [Health, Nutrition & Bio-Quant Hub](https://omnioperand.com/health/): Clinical and athletic physiological engines: BMR, TDEE, macronutrients, body fat percentages, hydration, and pharmacokinetics.
- [Geometry & Spatial Analysis Hub](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/): 2D and 3D geometric solvers: regular polygons, conic sections, polyhedra, surfaces of revolution, and radical closed-form proofs.
- [Physics & Engineering Mechanics Hub](https://omnioperand.com/physics/): Classical Newtonian kinematics, ballistics, electromagnetism, Ohm's law, fluid mechanics, and harmonic oscillation solvers.
- [Calculus & Mathematical Analysis Hub](https://omnioperand.com/calculus/): Computational engines for differentiation, integration, quadratic roots, linear systems, and algebraic structures.
- [Probability & Statistics Hub](https://omnioperand.com/statistics/): Stochastic models, probability mass/density functions, parameter estimation, z-scores, combinatorics, and Bayesian inference.

- [Parallelogram Area & Diagonals Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/parallelogram/): Calculate parallelogram area, perimeter, internal diagonals, and heights using base, side, and acute internal angle.
- [Kite Geometry & Area Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/kite/): Calculate kite area, perimeter, side pairs, and internal diagonal lengths from perpendicular diagonal axes.
- [Cylinder Volume & Surface Area Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/cylinder/): Calculate cylinder volume, lateral curved surface area, total surface area, and base perimeter from radius and height.
- [Right Circular Cone Volume & Slant Height Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/cone/): Calculate cone volume, slant height, lateral area, total surface area, and base cone angle from radius and vertical height.
- [Sphere Volume & Surface Area Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/sphere/): Calculate exact sphere volume, surface area, radius, diameter, and circumscribed cylinder ratio using Archimedes' theorem.
- [Torus Volume & Surface Area (Donut) Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/torus/): Calculate donut torus volume and surface area using Pappus's Centroid Theorems from major radius R and minor radius r.
- [Triangular Prism Volume & Surface Area Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/triangular-prism/): Calculate triangular prism volume, lateral face area, base area, and total surface area from triangular base dimensions and prism length.
- [Square Pyramid Volume & Slant Height Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/pyramid/): Calculate square and rectangular pyramid volume, lateral slant height, lateral face area, and total surface area.
- [Frustum of a Cone (Truncated Cone) Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/frustum-cone/): Calculate volume, lateral surface area, slant height, and total surface area of a truncated cone (frustum) from base radii and height.
- [Frustum of a Pyramid (Truncated Pyramid) Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/frustum-pyramid/): Calculate volume, slant height, and surface area of a truncated square pyramid from top base a₁, bottom base a₂, and height.
- [Ellipsoid Volume & Surface Area Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/ellipsoid/): Calculate ellipsoid volume and surface area using the Knud Thomsen p-norm approximation formula from semi-axes a, b, and c.
- [Arc Length, Sector Area & Chord Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/arc-length/): Calculate circular arc length (s), sector area, segment area, and chord length from circle radius and central angle (degrees or radians).

- [Z-Score & Standard Normal Distribution Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/statistics/z-score/): Calculate standard score z, cumulative probability P(Z < z), two-tailed p-value, and percentile rank in a standard normal distribution.
- [Permutations & Combinations (nPr & nCr) Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/statistics/permutations-combinations/): Calculate factorials, permutations (ordered nPr), and combinations (unordered binomial coefficients nCr) with exact integer precision.
- [Bayes' Theorem & Conditional Probability Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/statistics/bayes-theorem/): Calculate posterior probability P(A|B), prior odds, likelihood ratio, and diagnostic true/false positive rates using Bayes' rule.
